name: paint-bg-layers
_comment: CSS Backgrounds 3 §2.1 / §3.11. Two image layers (longhands and the background shorthand), per-layer background-clip, background-attachment:fixed against the viewport, and local versus scroll after a 24px scroll. Solid gradient stops so the pixels are flat colours. pixel_tolerance 1 absorbs the same Blink gradient dither as paint-gradient.
